important_uncertainties: The roughly 12,000-years-BP domestication timescale is a genomic demographic-model estimate with a broad interval, not a dated first farm.
The deeper natural geographic origin of Cannabis remains debated even though the 2021 genomic study supports early domestication in East Asia.
The true wild progenitor may be extinct, unsampled, or obscured by long cultivation and feralization.
Haimenkou seed morphometrics support diversification but cannot perfectly identify ancient end use.
Jirzankal establishes psychoactive cannabis burning by around 500 BCE, not the first psychoactive cannabis use ever or a proven standardized high-THC cultivar.
